propositions: Reconciler read and check paths currently call load_config() and inspect ambient environment/cwd, allowing runtime scope changes and config registry reloads during execution
Jira backends constructed without immutable settings bindings can reload ambient properties, causing project/query scope, TLS, timeout, and auth to become unstable across a single operation

Read/check call paths must be refactored to use focused immutable ReconcilerSettings, GitRuntime, and BridgeRuntime projections with exactly one selected Jira backend, ensuring properties remain stable after environment mutations

Secrets must be excluded from backend repr/equality/hash/cache/fingerprint and unwrapped only in the selected Jira sending adapter, with canaries validating absence at carrier, diagnostic, and wire boundaries

Supplied Python config and custom tracker directory/branch/remote must be authoritative for all read/ref/query owners; empty or malformed config/auth must fail before any provider request or local write
